Advertisement Notice
Respected Sir,
Applications are invited in the prescribed format for seven (07) contractual positions in the
Telemedicine Unit, King George’s Medical University, Lucknow. Eligible and interested candidates
possessing the requisite qualifications and experience may submit the duly completed application form
along with the required supporting documents, by email to telehealthservices@kgmcindia.edu on or
before 8 September 2026. Candidates are also required to submit the hard copy of the application form
(attached) at the Telemedicine Hub, 2nd Floor, Trauma Center, KGMU, Lucknow. Applications
submitted in hard copy or received after the prescribed deadline shall not be considered. Candidates are
also required to fill the Google link: https://forms.gle/5Ri6DTdpUM8qyGmx6
Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email. The interview is scheduled to be held on
12th September 2026 at 10:00 AM at the Kalam Center, King George’s Medical University,
Lucknow. No separate interview call letter will be issued by post. Candidates are therefore
advised to regularly check their registered email address for further communication.
No travelling allowance or dearness allowance shall be admissible for attending the interview.
The following positions are proposed to be advertised for the successful implementation of the project
entitled “Building capacity of local institutes for driving quality of care on eSanjeevani” under
supervision of Dr. Sheetal Verma, Nodal In-Charge, Telemedicine Unit & Additional Professor,
Department of Microbiology Lucknow.

Qualifications Consultant Monitoring, Evaluation, and Research- Telemedicine
Essential:
• Relevant master’s degree in public health, Health

• Minimum three years of demonstrated experience in

Desirable qualification:

programme evaluation, operational research, or public health

ii. Experience in developing performance indicators, assessment
frameworks, research protocols, and monitoring tools.
iii. Proficiency in data analysis and statistical software such as
SPSS, SAS, R, or other data visualization and analytics tools.
iv. Experience in data collection, analysis, report writing,
documentation, and dissemination of research findings.
v. Knowledge of research ethics, regulatory guidelines, and ethical
approval processes for healthcare research.
vi. Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and report
writing skills.
vii. Previous experience in Digital Health, Telemedicine,
Government Health Programmes, or projects supported by NHM
or development partners will be preferred.
